filing_office: North Dakota Secretary of State, Business Services
filing_fee_notes: Base registration fee for an ordinary business LLC.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an agent with a physical North Dakota address and obtain the agent's approval. The LLC cannot serve as its own agent, but a North Dakota resident individual from the business can.
annual_report_due: November 15, beginning the calendar year after registration, for ordinary business LLCs.
state_tax_registration_agency: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and keep a North Dakota registered agent. Ordinary business LLC annual reports are due November 15.
common_mistake: Do not use the agricultural LLC deadline for an ordinary business LLC.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic business LLC. Farming, ranching and authorized livestock LLCs have an April 15 report deadline. Tax URL covers withholding registration, not all tax accounts.
